title: A stopping car and its followers (Eclipse SUMO)
description: Eclipse SUMO simulates eight cars on an original straight road with a scheduled stop. Space–time traces show the computed car-following response.
description_ko: Eclipse SUMO로 직접 만든 직선 도로의 차량 8대와 선두 차량의 정차를 시뮬레이션했어요. 시공간 궤적으로 추종 반응을 살펴보세요.
prompt: A stopping car and its followers. Rerun the included recipe to change simulation inputs.
